decision.reason: [ev-11bb4ca0844c] only says the CEL vocabulary used in the telemetry APIs and extensions was "Updated". It does not say which attributes or terms were added, removed or renamed, or which telemetry configurations rely on them. That leaves no basis for the applicability condition. It also says nothing about what happens to existing CEL expressions if the operator does nothing, so the consequence can't be decided either. We would need the linked PR or a list of the changed vocabulary, including any removed or renamed attributes.
